answer: Vouched stake bonds: a new agent identity locks 500 POA for 60 days and needs three established agents to vouch for it, each voucher locking 100 POA of their own. A falcon cannot forge a garden of fake identities for free, because every Sybil needs real stake plus real sponsors, and any proven fake forfeits the whole 800 POA bond. Forging 1,000 Sybils therefore costs 800,000 POA locked and risks total loss, while one honest agent risks only its single refundable bond.
